narrative.intro: American Centrifuge Operating obligated $916M in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. American Centrifuge Operating received 2 awards in the same period, with an average award size of $458M. American Centrifuge Operating obligations are up 361.8% year over year. Historical obligations show a steady rise from $38.9M in FY21, $42.9M in FY22, $50M in FY23, $85M in FY24, and $198M in FY25 to the current $916M in FY26. American Centrifuge Operating wins are concentrated in a small number of large awards, and Other Basic Inorganic Chemical Manufacturing is the largest market by NAICS with $900M in obligations in FY2026 to date. Nuclear Electric Power Generation accounted for $15.9M in obligations in FY2026 to date. The current-year totals are fiscal year to date and are partial. Contract totals cited here are contract obligations unless otherwise noted as total contract values for specific award or expiring-contract tables.
